members.name: routing
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which kind of request is it? Pick the option that best describes what the customer needs.

criteria.activate_card: How to activate a newly received card, or whether it needs activating
criteria.card_expiring: Card is about to expire or has expired; getting a replacement for expiry
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the bank's own card can be used: which shops, ATMs or merchants take it (not whether the bank accepts a card the customer holds from another provider)
criteria.card_arrival: An ordered card has not arrived yet / tracking a card in the post
criteria.card_delivery_time: How long card delivery takes, delivery options, express delivery, choosing a delivery date
criteria.card_linking: Adding or linking a card to the app, or using again a card that was reported lost and has since been found
criteria.card_not_working: The card has stopped working in general, without a specific declined payment or withdrawal
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined or refused
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused the withdrawal / could not get cash out with the card
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits specific to disposable virtual cards: how many can be made, how many times one can be used
criteria.get_disposable_card: Getting a disposable (single-use) virtual card, what they are
criteria.virtual_card: Getting or accessing a regular virtual card
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable card not working or rejected
criteria.physical_card: Getting a physical/plastic card or ordering a card
criteria.spare_card: Getting an additional, second or spare card, card for a family member, cost of extra cards
criteria.visa_mastercard: Whether the bank issues Visa or Mastercard, choosing the card network
criteria.change_pin: Changing or setting the PIN, where to change it
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked, locked or rejected, or the customer forgot a PIN they had set. Not for a customer who cannot locate the PIN of a new card or has not received one (that is first_pin)
criteria.first_pin: Getting the PIN for a card: where to find it, cannot locate it, PIN not received yet, not having a PIN yet, when to set it up
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, ATM locations
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment the customer does not recognise or did not make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or wants to dispute
criteria.compromised_card: Card details or PIN may be compromised; someone else may be using the account; unusual activity
criteria.lost_stolen_card: Reporting a lost or stolen card that is still missing (not one that has since been found)
criteria.lost_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left somewhere; securing the app on a lost phone
criteria.request_refund: Wanting a refund for a purchase, item not delivered, changed mind, cancelling a purchase
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund that has not appeared yet
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less cash than requested
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted, cancelled or returned
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or reversing a transfer or a payment sent to the wrong account
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after depositing cash or a cheque
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary or a recipient is not allowed
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending or in progress, or an ATM withdrawal that was cancelled
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.transfer_not_received: The recipient has not received a transfer that was sent
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or deposit money into the account
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from others or receiving a salary into the account, including whether it can arrive in a particular currency
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or returned
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much money can be added to the account or used on the card, e.g. top-up limits, a daily limit on the card, maximum amounts
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up the account using a card
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: Topping up by cash or cheque
criteria.apple_google_pay: Anything about topping up or paying with Apple Pay, Google Pay or another phone wallet, including which currencies or cards work with it and why such a top-up fails
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a top-up, top-up verification code
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on card payments or purchases (including payments abroad, or new fees on payments the customer regularly makes), or a transaction that went through but carried a fee, even if the customer objects to it
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: A fee charged for withdrawing cash
criteria.fee_objection: The customer explicitly says a fee (a service charge) was levied on them that should not apply, without naming what it was for. Not for being charged an extra amount that the customer does not call a fee, not for asking what an unknown item on the statement is, and not for complaints about the exchange rate
criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are set, what the rate is
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra_charge_statement: An unexplained extra charge or small amount on the statement, or paying a little more than the expected price, that the customer does not describe as a fee for a particular kind of service. If the customer complains about fees on card purchases, payments abroad, transfers, ATM withdrawals, top-ups or exchanges, use that fee option instead. This includes a customer asking what an extra fee or charge seen on their statement or in the app is for
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the account can hold or convert between (not about receiving a salary in a currency)
criteria.top_up_bank_transfer_fee: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_card_fee: Fee for topping up by card
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged for a transfer
criteria.wrong_rate_card_payment: Wrong or higher-than-expected exchange rate applied to a card payment or purchase abroad (a complaint about the rate, not about a fee)
criteria.wrong_rate_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Whether the bank will take the customer's own card from another provider (a credit card, an American Express card, a foreign card) or a currency for adding money to the account. Not questions about whether the bank's own card is Visa or Mastercard
criteria.age_limit: Age requirement to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, which documents are needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten or reset app passcode, cannot log into the app
